- Full-text search can be re-enabled later with pg_trgm extension

- dockerfilePath: ./services/[service]/Dockerfile (path from repo root)
- Dockerfile COPY commands: COPY services/shared/, COPY services/auth-service/

- dockerContext: .
- dockerfilePath: ./backend/Dockerfile  
- Dockerfile: COPY backend/

- render.yaml: dockerContext changed from ./services to .
- All Dockerfiles: COPY commands now use services/ prefix
